Name: (CP) Adopt Pet - Sussie Magpie
Author: DolphinWhisperer9
Description:
Adopt Pet - Sussie Magpie allows you to add Sussie as a pet option. In order to adopt Sussie, you'll need to max out your friendship with your first pet so that extra pet licenses can be unlocked. You can then adopt Sussie from Marnie's Adopt Pets menu, default cost is 50,000. If you want to change the price, you can do so via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

If you don't want to put in the manual work to raise friendship, then I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30471?tab=description]JP's Utility Commands[/url] to change your pet's friendship points. Please note, it isn't possible to get Sussie as your first pet.

[u]To install:[/u]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
I'm not a coder by trade so this was made with a lot of trial and error! I can't guarantee that I'll be able to fix a bug due to my lack of knowledge but I'll do my best! 


[i]If you like this mod, please consider checking out my other work. I made this in my free time but I'm mainly a digital artist. You can find my previous artwork on my site, [url=http://artfullyyoursartwork.com/]artfullyyoursartwork.com[/url]! If you so choose, you can also [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/artfullyyours]buy me a coffee[/url]! Thanks everyone!
